Title: Spring 2024 Class Schedule
Type: HTML

Spring 2024 Class Schedule
There are three different types of modes of instruction: Fully Online, Hybrid, and In-Person (definitions linked). Some instruction modes and classes times may change before registration opens.
The Spring 2024 class schedule will be available on Tuesday, October 18, 2023. Spring 2024 appointments are viewable on MySJSU on Tuesday, October 18, 2023.
Spring 2024 Registration opens for SJSU Students on Tuesday, October 31, 2023. Registration for Non-SJSU students begins on January 24, 2024.
Spring 2024 Registration closes on Monday, January 22, 2024.
Online Learning Readiness
Before enrolling in an online course, students should first assess their readiness for stepping into the online learning environment by completing the Online Learning Readiness Questionnaire.Subject Notes
Subject Notes, also referred to as Global Notes, provide more details about a specific subject, course and/or section. Available for courses with subject codes: CCS | CHAD | CHIN | CMPE | EDSE | ENVS | FLED | FORL | FREN | GERM | GRK | HEBR | INFO | ITAL | JPN | LATN | PORT | RTVF | RUSS | SOCI | SPAN | TA | TAG | VIET
Using the Search
Use the Search bar to filter by section and/or mode of instruction (e.g. typing "Fully Online MATH" will provide a list of all MATH courses taught fully online.)
When the schedule indicates TBA (to be announced) it means that the class is scheduled with no designated day/time meetings.
Real-time class listings, including textbook and course information, are found at one.sjsu.edu by searching for 'Class Search' in the Search Box.
